name: The Black Box
summary: A giant condor in the Badlands swallowed a black box marked for Ironforge.

sections.title: Pulled from a Condor
sections.body: After ages in the condor's stomach, acid had pitted the metal. A symbol marks the underside above the words Engine #19 - Ironforge Siege Brigade. You carry the box to Pilot Longbeard in Ironforge's Hall of Arms.

faq.q: Where did the corroded black box come from?
aliases: where did the box come from
how did the box get here
faq.answer: A giant condor in the Badlands swallowed the box, and it seems to have lain in its stomach for ages.

faq.q: What markings are stamped on the box?
faq.answer: A symbol is stamped on the underside above the words Engine #19 - Ironforge Siege Brigade.

faq.q: Who is supposed to receive the box?
aliases: where does the black box go
who do i bring the box to
faq.answer: Pilot Longbeard, in the Hall of Arms in Ironforge.

angles.text: The box bears Ironforge's mark, and its trail leads to Ironforge.
